title: Finite Q3 GNS transport compatibility under word enlargement and Euclidean time translation
question: When the finite Q3 OS word block is enlarged by one ordered product and one Euclidean time translate, does the state-dependent polar transport remain compatible with the previously selected block across nested volumes?

model.base_block: At base tau values use q, p, qp and pq; this is the EXP-001181 block.
model.extension: Add the ordered product qpq and the translated Euclidean time fraction 0.375, producing a finite expanded block.

exact_interface.lean: R342 proves the finite invertible-matrix congruence used by every positive Gram polar map.
exact_interface.base_transport: For base Gram blocks G_s=R_s^2 and G_l=R_l^2, M_base=R_l^-1 R_s obeys M_base^* G_l M_base=G_s.
exact_interface.expanded_transport: The expanded block has M_exp=R_l,exp^-1 R_s,exp and the same finite congruence; compatibility is tested by restricting M_exp to the base coordinates and comparing it with M_base.
exact_interface.boundary: A finite restricted-map residual is a block-compatibility diagnostic; it is not a spatial inductive embedding, an action intertwiner, a common representation, or an exhaustion theorem.

adversarial_review.check: The added point is exactly the declared translated_tau_fraction and remains inside the positive Euclidean half-period for both beta values; no continuous-time claim is inferred.
Only qpq is added, with its order preserved; arbitrary products, adjoints, commutator closure and the full local algebra are not silently included.
The expanded polar map is restricted using the explicit base-coordinate index map, and this restriction is not called an algebra homomorphism or a canonical embedding.
Both base and expanded Gram blocks are checked above the support floor before inverse roots are formed; ill-conditioned directions remain reported.
Base and expanded congruence residuals are separately checked against the declared numerical tolerance, while compatibility residuals are reported without an unjustified smallness threshold.
Each volume and beta uses its own partition function and polar factors; a beta-dependent finite map is not promoted to a state-independent carrier.
Minimum eigenvalues and condition numbers are retained so a tiny residual is not confused with stable thermodynamic control.
The independent lane reconstructs the Q3 Hamiltonian, ordered words, time translates, Gram blocks and polar maps without importing the primary program.
R342 certifies only the finite matrix congruence identity under invertibility; the word/time compatibility residuals and all limits remain Python evidence/open analysis.
A finite compatibility diagnostic does not prove action intertwining, a spatial net, all-shape Cauchy, common alpha, Hamiltonian-OS identification, a gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.

lean_crosscheck.role: R342 supplies the exact finite algebraic congruence used for both base and expanded polar maps; it does not assert time-translate compatibility or any limit.

qft_interface.open: Compatibility under further words and real-time translates, product/star/action intertwining, a spatial inductive net, source/volume/cutoff/beta-uniform Cauchy, common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, GNS gap and continuum remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: Auxiliary C6/Q3 finite evidence only; no heat_root_incidence, canonical A1/R-192 production owner, physical-empty reference, Sector-A closure or Pre-A closure is supplied.

next_action: If the restricted-map residual remains block- or beta-dependent, retain this as finite compatibility evidence only and derive an analytic uniform action-intertwining/source-boundary estimate; if it is small on this fixture, test a second independent word/time extension before any promotion.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite nested Q3 word/time compatibility checkpoint. It is not a thermodynamic common-Hilbert theorem, a common-alpha construction, a mass-gap proof, a continuum result, or a QFT/Clay closure.
no_overclaim: This package promotes only the finite positive support, finite polar congruences, and the declared restricted-map/time-translate compatibility diagnostic. It does not prove or refute another common OS carrier, action-compatible spatial transport, direct Cauchy convergence, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, a GNS gap, continuum removal, C6, Sector A, Pre-A or a Clay result.
